'''Mirthen''' was a [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]], the second-in-command to [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jayhawk]] of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Martinette]]''.<ref name="Godking" /> Mirthen was an addict to the narcotic [[Waste-it]], commonly carrying two sticks of it along with his [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] and a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] he could hardly use. He was however quite adept in melee combat, [[Starship/Legends|starship]] gunnery, and [[Ocean/Legends|aquatic]] survival. Nevertheless, Jayhawk had not promoted him because of this; he did because Mirthen was unambitious and would not conspire to replace Jayhawk.<ref name="Godking-CC">{{WEGCite|story=Tests of the Godking|book=Classic Campaigns}}</ref> Mirthen was onboard the ''Martinette'' in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], when Jayhawk ordered to attack the pleasure yacht ''[[Long Shot]]''.<ref name="Godking" />
